name: mcpb-creator
description: Guide for creating Model Context Protocol Bundles (MCPB). Use when users want to build MCP servers as distributable bundles with proper manifest structure, tool definitions, security measures, and best practices.
author: JJ Halans
triggers: define MCP tools in a manifest

usage.prompt: Guide the user through defining tools, initialising a bundle with init_mcpb.py, writing the manifest.json and server/index.js, applying security measures (path validation, timeouts, input sanitisation), and validating with validate_mcpb.py. Reference references/manifest-spec.md for schema details and references/implementation-guide.md for patterns.

bundleName.description: Kebab-case name for the new MCPB bundle.

toolDefinitions.description: List of tool names or descriptions the bundle should expose.

outputPath.description: Directory where the bundle folder should be created.

bundleDirectory.description: Path to the created bundle directory.

validationResult.description: Output of validate_mcpb.py confirming the bundle is valid.
